title: GavioResponse
description: The canonical response returned to the caller, enriched by the post-interceptor pipeline.

traceId.description: Same UUID v7 as the request.

content.description: Final response text (PII restored). The empty string when the model responded only with toolCalls.

toolCalls.description: Tool calls the model requested, in provider order (F-ADP-03). Absent or empty when none. Arguments have PII placeholders restored, like content. Python binds this key as tool_calls.

finishReason.description: Normalised stop reason (F-ADP-03). OpenAI/Azure/OpenRouter: stop->stop, length->length, tool_calls->tool_calls, content_filter->content_filter. Anthropic: end_turn and stop_sequence->stop, max_tokens->length, tool_use->tool_calls, refusal->content_filter. Gemini: STOP->stop, MAX_TOKENS->length, SAFETY/RECITATION/BLOCKLIST/PROHIBITED_CONTENT/SPII->content_filter. Ollama: stop->stop, length->length. Any other native value maps to other. When the response carries toolCalls and the native reason is a plain stop (Gemini, Ollama), the value is tool_calls. Null when the provider reports none. Python binds this key as finish_reason.

audit.description: AuditRecord, if the audit interceptor ran.
